app.q: Do my clients need to download an app?
app.a: No. They open your link in their phone's browser and create an account with their name, email and phone the first time.

team.a: Yes. Each barber has their own hours, services and bookings, and you can manage everyone's schedule.

closed.q: What if I am closed one day?
closed.a: Mark it as a day off. That day stops showing for booking and any existing appointments are cancelled.

double.a: No. The system checks the time and the length of the service before confirming, even when two clients book at the same moment.

noshow.q: What if a client does not show up?
noshow.a: Record it as a no-show. If it keeps happening, you can block them from booking at your barbershop.

english.a: Yes. Every page your clients see is available in Spanish and in English.

pay.a: The first 30 days are free. After that the membership is monthly and, for now, payment is arranged directly with us.

cta.text: Set up your barbershop today and share your link with your clients tomorrow morning.
